messages:
Mia Chen: customer reporting token cost dashboard showing $0 for several orgs (example org_id org_9a7). they noticed it starting 2026-03-10, across daily and monthly views. attaching org id and screenshot in thread.

Jordan Park: can you paste the org_id and a quick repro? do we see token events in raw logs or are those missing too?

Mia Chen: repro steps: 1) open Console -> Billing -> Token cost 2) select org 'Acme Labs (org_9a7)' 3) period 03/01-03/15 4) totals show $0.00, tokens column still populated. logs: billing_events show records for that org. snippet:
```
select org_id, date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd
from billing_events
where org_id = 'org_9a7' and ts >= '2026-03-01'
group by 1,2
order by 2;
-- result: tokens > 0, cost_usd = 0.0 for every row
```

Liam O'Neill: thanks. that suggests the aggregation is zeroing cost during the ETL/aggregation step rather than missing raw events. can you also dump the transformed table used by dashboard: billing_aggregates_daily?

Mia Chen: pulled billing_aggregates_daily and saw many rows with cost_usd = 0 while tokens > 0. this only affects orgs created before 2026-03-01. new orgs look fine.

Jordan Park: curious — any recent deploy around 2026-03-09 to billing ingest or cost-calculator service? quota-bot: deploy-bot shows a canary of cost-calc v2.1.3 at 2026-03-09T18:12Z.

quota-bot: deploy event: service=cost-calc image=cost-calc:v2.1.3 sha=abcd123 status=success env=prod time=2026-03-09T18:12:04Z

Anika Rao: product note — customers complained about a spike in cost last week; we asked infra to roll out config change to enable per-tenant discounts. could that change have affected cost computation?

Jordan Park: possible. I'm looking at the cost-calc diff. v2.1.3 introduced a new join on tenant_pricing table and defaulted discount_pct to 100% when tenant_pricing entry not found (oops). code snippet:
```python
# previous: discount_pct = pricing_row.get('discount_pct', 0.0)
# bug in v2.1.3: discount_pct = pricing_row['discount_pct']  # KeyError -> fallback to 100 later in pipeline
```
This could turn cost to zero if discount_pct becomes 100%.

Liam O'Neill: that matches symptoms: older tenants without pricing rows get the default overwritten. we should patch to default to 0.0.

Mia Chen: customer impacted list: org_9a7, org_33f, org_5c2. reported via support ticket #TKT-2309. they're asking for immediate correction and payout adjustments.

Jordan Park: plan: 1) hotfix patch to cost-calc to default discount_pct=0.0 and redeploy (estimate 10-15m) 2) one-off backfill to recompute cost for affected orgs for range 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-15 3) notify customers and create billing adjustments 4) postmortem. who owns backfill?

Liam O'Neill: I'll run the backfill job once patch is live. need DB write access for billing_aggregates_daily. will run calculation locally against staging first. command I'll run:
```bash
python backfill_costs.py --org org_9a7,org_33f,org_5c2 --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-15 --dry-run
```

Anika Rao: please add a note to the Console that values may be temporarily incorrect while we backfill. also flag this for SLA/billing review.

Jordan Park: patch merged to main and rolling deploy started. stepping canary to 10% now.

quota-bot: deploy event: service=cost-calc image=cost-calc:v2.1.4 sha=efgh456 status=success env=prod time=2026-03-10T15:02:12Z

Jordan Park: canaries look clean, no errors in logs. proceeding to 100%.

Liam O'Neill: running backfill dry-run, tokens match expected, cost recomputed non-zero. executing live backfill now. estimate ~35 minutes for the three orgs.

Mia Chen: letting customers know we'll adjust invoices and will follow up with final numbers.

Liam O'Neill: backfill complete. verified dashboard now shows non-zero costs for affected orgs. spot-checked totals against raw billing_events.

Mia Chen: notified customers, created billing adjustments, and issued apologies + credit for the period. ticket TKT-2309 updated with final numbers. :white_check_mark:

Anika Rao: creating postmortem checklist item: stricter defaults on joins, add unit test for missing pricing rows, add alert when aggregate cost deviates >50% from expected baseline across tenants.

Jordan Park: closing thread — root cause: faulty default handling in cost-calc v2.1.3 causing discount_pct to be interpreted as 100% for tenants without pricing rows; fix deployed and backfill applied. follow-ups: billing adjustments, unit tests, alert.

Mia Chen: thx everyone :pray:
